0022600122.text: The Mavericks are 1-1 on the road, have won their last game, and sit 3rd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and 9th in the West, while the Miami Heat are 0-2 at home, on a two-game losing streak, and 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back, and 15th in the East. Dallas is missing six players: Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain; 23.0 points per game this season), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee; 19.5 points per game this season), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Miami has no listed absences. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Mavericks winning the most recent meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
